europe_now.title: Russian Drone Found off Polish Coast
europe_now.summary: Polish prosecutors reported that a Russian drone discovered off the country's coast was equipped with an explosive warhead. Poland subsequently reaffirmed its strong support for Ukraine following these security incursions.

sources.headline: Russian drone found off Poland’s coast carried explosive warhead, prosecutor says
Poland reiterates Ukraine support after Russia drone attacks

europe_now.title: Kosovo War Crimes Sentencing
europe_now.summary: The Hague court sentenced Kosovo's former president, Hashim Thaçi, to 25 years in prison following war crimes convictions. The high-profile international ruling marked a major legal development regarding the Balkan conflicts.

sources.headline: Hague court sentences Kosovo ex-president Thaçi to 25 years in prison for war crimes
Kosovo's former president sentenced to 25 years for war crimes

top_stories.title: European Union Leadership and Strategic Initiatives
top_stories.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen delivered her State of the European Union address in Brussels. During the speech, she proposed an associate membership framework for Canada, catching various EU capitals off guard.

sources.headline: EU capitals caught off guard as von der Leyen announces ‘associate membership’ for Canada

top_stories.title: Regional Security and Drone Incursions
top_stories.summary: Authorities in Poland addressed ongoing regional security threats after a Russian drone carrying an explosive warhead was recovered off the coast. Polish leadership reiterated their firm commitment to supporting Ukraine amid these airspace violations.
